title: Meet work health and safety duties to employees (Seacare operators)
what: Operators of prescribed ships and units must take all reasonable steps to protect the health and safety at work of their employees.

laws.title: Occupational Health and Safety (Maritime Industry) Act 1993

sources.title: Occupational Health and Safety (Maritime Industry) Act 1993
sources.quote: 11 Duties of operators in relation to their employees (1) An operator of a prescribed ship or prescribed unit must take all reasonable steps to protect the health and safety at work of employees.
